compartment.title: Fix LLM connectivity and CCI visual bugs
compartment.p1:
U: "Fix the LLM unreachable bug, and then ensure that the default metrics for the individuals are calculated, not hardcoded as red. Proceed with investigating these bugs so that you can fix them all"
Investigated and resolved two immediate issues in the CLI. First, found that the LLM health check was timing out at 3 seconds while the proxy typically took ~3.5 seconds to respond, causing the "unreachable" error; resolved this by increasing the timeout. Second, fixed a Chalk rendering bug in the CCI dimensions display where color functions were being printed as raw code (e.g., `${color}`) instead of being called with values.
Verified both fixes and began investigating the "hardcoded red" metrics issue. Discovered that the Significator currently defaults to the Red stage on creation, and confirmed that all 8 lines show identical `■■●○○○○○ Red` metrics upon initialization. Investigation into the calculation logic in `src/core` is ongoing.
compartment.p2: Fixed an LLM "unreachable" bug by increasing the health check timeout to accommodate proxy latency (>3s). Resolved a Chalk rendering issue in the CCI dimensions display. Began investigating why Significator metrics are hardcoded to the Red stage on creation.
compartment.p3: Resolved LLM connectivity timeout and CCI visual rendering bugs; investigation into default "Red" metrics is ongoing.
compartment.p4: LLM timeout; CCI Chalk fix; Red metrics investigation

facts.CONSTRAINTS: * The LLM proxy response time typically exceeds 3 seconds, requiring a health check timeout higher than the default 3s to avoid "unreachable" errors.

causal_incident.summary: LLM proxy latency causes health check timeout
causal_incident.symptom: LLM reported as unreachable in the CLI
causal_incident.cause_summary: The health check timeout was set to 3 seconds, but the proxy took ~3.5 seconds to respond.
causal_incident.evidence: "The health check times out at 3 seconds, but the proxy takes ~3.5 seconds to respond."
